description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz.Ex.No. 2130/26 of 03.07.2019 - Cad. Map No. 820047 and Other Amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections to parcel numbers, village names, and Grama Niladhari Division designations for multiple land plots in the Mathara district. The content falls under "PART III - LANDS" and involves land title settlement matters, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) according to the classification criteria.
